posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought Merck stock, 7,842 of them from 1970 to 2001. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 47% are red.
Ten years: still 1,128 red.

At 25 years and 6 months, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in November 1999 and was red for over twenty five years. It only turned green in 2025.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded.
